command: ENCODE long-read RNA GTF -> SQANTI3 qc -> panisoguard adjudicate --pangenome-junctions <whole-genome HPRC deletions> --pangenome-provenance population
data_provenance: TWO real PUBLIC samples: GM12878 (NA12878) ONT dRNA (ENCODE ENCSR368UNC) and K562 ONT dRNA (ENCSR917JIA); SQANTI3 vs GENCODE v49. Pangenome junctions = whole-genome HPRC v1.1 Minigraph-Cactus deletions >=50bp (71,435 junctions, all chr1-22/X/Y). Both samples are OUT of the HPRC graph's 47 assembly samples (non-circular).
notes: Whole-genome pangenome specificity on two independent real public samples (GM12878 + K562), extending GATE-1 from chr22 to the whole genome: 0 false rescues across 75,740 novel isoforms / 190,713 novel introns vs 71,435 whole-genome HPRC population-deletion junctions. No novel junction coincides exactly with a population deletion (near-misses at chance level), so reference bias through population deletions is rare in these samples; the pangenome axis is a check with a low base rate, not a discovery axis. A null result on the discovery question; the specificity holds. Reproducible from public ENCODE/HPRC inputs (no private data).
